items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: But, uh, we had Freddie Keppard there with us, and he still was, he still was hot.

ctx.x: He was a great showman, yeah. Sweatman and so forth. Yeah, yeah. A good pattern of showman, yeah.
But, uh, we had Freddie Keppard there with us, and he still was, he still was hot.

Yeah, in connection with Keppard there was always a lot of contention amongst the old timers as to whether Keppard kind of had a shade on the trumpet, or whether, no, Oliver was the right man and so forth. Mm-hmm. Did you have any feeling about that yourself? Or did they follow one after another, as Oliver and Louie really followed one after another?
